title: Phast
description:
A `phast.toml` manifest: what a project is, what it depends on,
and how Phast should resolve and install it.

require-dev.description: Dev-only dependencies, for development and testing.

conflict.description: Package versions this project is incompatible with.

autoload.description: Autoload rules for the project's own code.

autoload-dev.description: Autoload rules applied only when dev dependencies are installed.

repositories.description: Extra package registries and single-package endpoints.

workspace.description: Workspace root configuration and its members.

extra.description: Free-form data for tooling; not interpreted by Phast.

version.description:
The project's version, e.g. `"1.0.0"`. Required for workspace members that other
members depend on.

description.description: A short description of the project.

keywords.description: Searchable tags used when publishing to a registry.

support.description: Support channels, keyed by channel name (issues, source, docs, ...).

role.description: Role within the project, e.g. `"maintainer"` or `"contributor"`.

Support.description:
Support channels for a package, each mapping a channel name to a URL or address,
e.g. `issues`, `source`, `docs`, `email`, `chat`.

url.description: URL of the funding or sponsorship page.

RequireSection.description:
Project dependencies: each package name mapped to a version constraint.

Keys are `vendor/package` names or platform packages like `php` and `ext-json`.
A value is a version constraint (e.g. `"^7.0"`), or `{ workspace = true }`
to inherit the constraint from the workspace root.

DependencySpec.description:
A dependency value: a version constraint (e.g. `"^7.0"`), or `{ workspace = true }`
to inherit the constraint from the workspace root.

WorkspaceRef.description: Inherit a dependency's version constraint from the workspace root.

workspace.description: Set to `true` to take the constraint from the root's `[workspace.dependencies]`.

ProvideSection.description:
Virtual packages this project provides, each package name mapped to the version
provided (`*` or `self.version` allowed).

ReplaceSection.description:
Packages this project supplies itself, each package name mapped to the version
replaced (`*` or `self.version` allowed).

ConflictSection.description:
Packages this project is incompatible with, each package name
mapped to a constraint of versions to exclude.

SuggestSection.description: Optional packages, each package name mapped to a human-readable reason.

AutoloadSection.description:
Autoloading rules for the project's own code, compiled into the generated autoloader
alongside every dependency's rules. A PSR prefix maps to one path or a list of paths.

psr-4.description:
A PSR-4 namespace prefix mapped to its path (or list of paths).
Insertion-ordered, so a handwritten order survives a round trip.

psr-0.description:
A PSR-0 namespace prefix mapped to its path (or list of paths).
Insertion-ordered, so a handwritten order survives a round trip.

classmap.description: Directories or files scanned for class definitions.

files.description: Files always loaded by the autoloader, e.g. global helper functions.

exclude.description: Path patterns kept out of the generated classmap.

ScriptsSection.description:
Lifecycle hooks and named tasks. A key is a lifecycle event (e.g. `post-install`) or
a task name you run with `phast run <name>`; its value is a single command or a list
of commands run in order.

Script.description:
A single command, or a list of commands run in order.

A command is a shell line, an `@php` invocation, or a `Vendor\Class::method` callback.

anyOf.description: Commands run in the order given.

minimum-stability.description: Lowest release stability the resolver may select. Defaults to `stable`.

minimum-package-age.description:
Minimum age a package version must have before it can be selected.

Expressed as a duration string: `"24h"`, `"7d"`, `"2w"`.
Versions published more recently than this threshold are excluded.

prefer-stable.description: When `true`, prefer stable releases over pre-releases of equal constraint fit.

classmap-authoritative.description:
Generate the autoloader in classmap-authoritative mode: trust
the classmap exclusively and drop the PSR filesystem fallback.

sort-packages.description:
When `true`, sort every dependency section on each write, platform packages
first and then alphabetically.

platform.description: Platform version overrides used during resolution.

secure-http.description:
Reject plaintext `http://` registry URLs. Enabled by default;
set to `false` to allow a trusted internal registry served over HTTP.

platform-check.description:
Whether `platform_check.php` is generated, and how much it verifies:
`"php"`, `"all"`, or `"off"`. Absent means the `php` default.

allow-plugins.description:
Plugin execution allowlist: `"vendor/plugin" = true` to allow, `false` to block.
Reserved: an entry here is recorded and has no effect on what runs.

Platform.description:
Platform version overrides, so resolution behaves the same
regardless of the locally installed PHP and extensions.

php.description: Override the PHP version used during resolution, e.g. `"8.2"`.

RepositoryDef.description: An extra registry or single-package source endpoint.

type.description: What kind of repository this is.

name.description: Name used to reference this repository from `[sources]`.

default.description: When `true`, packages not listed in `[sources]` are fetched from this repository.

RepositoryType.description:
The `type` of a `[[repositories]]` entry: what a user writes in a manifest.

`Vcs` and `Git` are two spellings of the same thing and behave identically, since
the host driver is chosen from the URL (`host_for`), not from this type. Both are
accepted because both appear in real manifests.

oneOf.description: Generic VCS repository (the backend is detected from the URL).
Packagist (the default registry); can be disabled or redirected.

SourcesSection.description:
Where individual packages come from, mapping each `"vendor/package"` name to its
source: a named `[[repositories]]` endpoint, a single-package git source, a local
path, or an inline package.

SourceSpec.description:
A single `[sources]` entry: where one package comes from. Which fields you set
selects the kind of source:

- `repository` - fetch from the named `[[repositories]]` endpoint.
- `path` - a local package on disk (optionally with `symlink` and `version`).
- `url` with `version` - a self-describing inline package.
- `url` with no `version` - a git source, whose metadata is read from the repository.

repository.description: Name of the `[[repositories]]` endpoint this package is fetched from.

url.description: Clone URL of a single-package git source or inline package.

reference.description: Exact commit reference to check out (git source or inline package).

path.description: Filesystem path to a local package directory.

symlink.description:
Symlink a path package into `vendor/`. Only `true` is accepted: copying is
not supported, so `symlink = false` is rejected rather than silently ignored.

version.description:
The package's version. Supplies the version for a path source,
or (with `url`) marks a self-describing inline package.

WorkspaceSection.description:
Marks this manifest as a workspace root and configures its members.
Present only in a root manifest.

members.description:
Glob patterns that identify member directories, relative to the workspace root.
Each matched directory must contain a `phast.toml` to be treated as a member.

exclude.description: Glob patterns that exclude directories from membership even if they match `members`.

dependencies.description:
Shared version constraints that members inherit with `{ workspace = true }`. Values
are plain version constraints; whether a member treats one as dev-only is decided in
its own `[require]` or `[require-dev]`.

ExtraSection.description:
Free-form data for plugins and framework tooling.
Phast preserves it but does not interpret it.
